literal_source_claim_en: Bifurcation in which periodic solutions arise.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies no differential-system model, state space, regularity, equilibrium branch, critical eigenvalue multiplicity, remaining-spectrum condition, transversality, harmonic or nonlinear nondegeneracy, periodic-solution and phase conventions, parameter side, local uniqueness, normal-form, or stability conclusion.
